summary: Malheur NF lookout: a 30-foot round timber tower with an enclosed cab, built 1933 and discontinued 1954; the directory marks it removed.

facts.design: 30-foot round timber tower with an enclosed cab
facts.status_note: The directory marks the lookout removed; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: 30-foot round timber tower with an enclosed cab

evidence.supports: built 1933: 30-foot round timber tower with an enclosed cab
evidence.quote: 1933: A 30-foot round timber tower with an enclosed cab was constructed.

evidence.supports: section 15 in the Grant County index

notes_for_editor: The build year and discontinuation year come from one directory entry, with no second source found. The site page (16S-29E-16) and the Grant County index (16S-29E-15) disagree on the section; not resolved, and the story reports both. The index's alternate name East Flagtail appears in no other source checked. Searches and the local caches turned up no NHLR, firelookout.com or Forest Service entry for this site. The record's 9.1 m height matches the directory's 30-foot figure.
